stories.title: Bank of Canada may raise rates in October, raising concerns for Canadian housing market
stories.summary: The Bank of Canada has not raised its policy rate since July 2023 and an eighth‑consecutive hold is widely expected at its upcoming meeting. A growing number of economists and traders now anticipate a rate increase on Oct. 28 to address persistent inflation. Experts say a hike would increase variable‑rate mortgage payments, reduce the pool of qualified buyers and could push home prices lower.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.

stories.title: 65‑year‑old swimmer killed in shark attack off South Africa’s east coast
stories.summary: Janine Lochrenberg, 65, was swimming off a beach in KuGompo City (formerly East London) on Tuesday morning when she was attacked by a shark at about 08:00 local time (06:00 GMT). Witnesses said she was bitten in two places and died before she could be brought ashore. It is the first recorded fatal shark attack in South Africa this year, and the country has had about ten fatal attacks since 2012.
stories.why: The incident highlights the rare but serious risk that shark encounters pose to open‑water swimmers in the region.
